text:
Alex: Heads-up — customer acme-marketing claims promo code checked out but org balance unchanged. UI shows green check. Escalating.
EngOncallBot: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T15:04:22Z acknowledged to prod (:rocket:)
Mira: Pasted the confirmation email from the customer: 'Voucher applied to billing account #b-1023, amount: $500.00'. Screenshot attached. UI shows success. No ledger entry under org o-77.
Alex: @BillingOps can you confirm whether the grant landed on b-1023 instead of o-77? Ticket INC-8421 opened.
BillingOps: digging in logs — webhook consumer received grant callback and created a grant record with account_type=billing_account, account_id=b-1023. The billing ledger shows a pending credit for b-1023. Looks like mapping went to billing instead of org.
Zane: Any recent changes to partner mapping logic? The mapping should prefer org when external_org_id is present.
Samir: Quick repro notes from local: claim via SSO flow -> partner webhook payload contains external_org_id and external_billing_id. Current consumer code: if external_org_id resolves to an org then map to org; else map to billing. I see a race where org lookup returns null when partner mapping cache stale, then fallback maps to billing_account. We should verify org existence by primary key and not just cache.
Samir: example payload we saw in logs:
```json
{
  "event": "promo.claimed",
  "external_org_id": "ext-org-ACME",
  "external_billing_id": "ext-b-1023",
  "code": "SPRING-ACME-500",
  "amount": 50000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "claim_method": "sso"
}
```
Samir: repro curl to simulate webhook (use staging keys):
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.example/partner-grants -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @payload.json
```
Alex: Customer asking for immediate remedy. Can we credit org and reverse billing credit?
BillingOps: We can manually reverse the ledger on b-1023 and post a credit to o-77. Will create compensating entries and an audit note referencing INC-8421. ETA ~1h. Proceeding unless someone objects. :thumbsup:
Zane: I'll open a small fix: tighten mapping, add a DB-backed lookup before fallback, add unit test and a prometheus alert for grants routed to billing when external_org_id present. PR GH#4567.
Mira: I'll tell the customer we've initiated a manual fix and will confirm when credits appear. Thanks team.
Alex: Thank you — please post the ledger tx ids here once done so I can confirm with customer.
